title: UniFi Network Controller
wrapper_note:
the upstream image boots with the s6-overlay v3 init, which runs as root and
prepares /config plus the /usr/lib/unifi/{data,logs} paths before starting the
bundled Java controller. TOS forbids root containers, so src/entrypoint.sh
does the same preparation and runs the same Java command as the unprivileged
container user; the two image paths are bind-mounted from the data folder.
wrapper_note_readme: - **Entrypoint wrapper** (not a privilege shim): the image's s6 init needs root to prepare its data paths, so `src/entrypoint.sh` performs that setup and starts the bundled UniFi Java controller directly as the unprivileged container user.
user_mode_text: 上游镜像以 root 的 s6 初始化 /config 与 /usr/lib/unifi 下的数据目录，入口包装改为以 uid 1000 完成同样的初始化
user_mode_cons:
- 上游镜像的 s6 init 以 root 建目录、把 /usr/lib/unifi/{data,logs} 链到 /config，再启动 Java
  控制器（控制器自带 MongoDB）。`user: "1000:1000"` 时这套 init 跑不了。
- 本包把 /usr/lib/unifi/data、/usr/lib/unifi/logs 直接从应用数据目录 bind mount 进来（属主 1000），
  `src/entrypoint.sh` 只做「建目录 + 首次播种 system.properties + 启动同一条 Java 命令」。
- 实测非 root 下控制器可启动，HTTPS 8443 有应答，数据落在挂载卷内。
healthcheck_note: 用 `curl -k` 探 HTTPS 8443（自签证书，根路径可能返回 404，能应答即健康）；首次启动要初始化数据库，`start_period` 给 300s。
descript: The UniFi Network Controller manages Ubiquiti UniFi access points, switches and gateways: adopt devices, configure Wi-Fi networks and VLANs, see clients and traffic, update firmware and read statistics - all from a local web UI instead of the cloud. This package runs the LinuxServer.io Docker image as a non-root container and keeps the controller database, configuration and logs in the application data folder.
important: Requires DockerEngine (installed if missing); add a registry mirror if Docker Hub is unreachable. Open https://<NAS-IP>:8013/ and finish the wizard (self-signed certificate). Devices need inform 8014/tcp and discovery 8016/udp on the LAN. Data lives in the application data folder; back it up before uninstalling with data removal. The bundled controller is frozen at 8.0.24 (legacy image).
release_note: 1. First release: UniFi Network Controller 8.0.24 from the LinuxServer.io Docker Hub image, running as a non-root container with the web UI, device-inform, STUN and discovery ports published. Controller data and logs are kept in the application data folder.
data_notes: `data/` (mounted at `/usr/lib/unifi/data`) holds `system.properties`, the `db/` MongoDB database, `keystore/` and the adoption credentials; `logs/` holds the controller logs; `config/` is the working directory. Copying the `unificontrollerdocker` folder is a complete backup of the controller.
design_notes: **Non-root by construction.** The image's s6 init needs root to prepare its data paths, so the wrapper prepares them itself and runs the bundled Java controller as `1000:1000`; `/usr/lib/unifi/data` and `/usr/lib/unifi/logs` are bind-mounted from the application data folder so they are writable.
**Fixed image tag `8.0.24`**, Docker Hub only, no `privileged`, no `network_mode: host`, no `cap_add`, no Docker socket.
**Multi-port by necessity**: 8013/tcp web UI, 8014/tcp device inform, 8015/udp STUN, 8016/udp discovery. Only the web UI is opened by the App Center.
**Health check** over HTTPS with `curl -k` (self-signed certificate) and a 300 s start period.
limitations: The LinuxServer.io UniFi image is legacy: Ubiquiti moved to the "UniFi Network Application" with an external MongoDB. This package keeps 8.0.24 working but new controller features and updates are not available until the image is rebased.
Devices must be able to reach ports 8014/tcp (inform) and 8016/udp (discovery) on the NAS; if you change the ports in docker-compose.yml, also point the devices at the new inform address.
The UI is HTTPS with a self-signed certificate. Put it behind a TLS reverse proxy if you expose it outside the LAN.

runtime_files.lifecycle: never delete; without it adopted devices cannot be managed

zh-cn.descript: UniFi Network Controller 用来管理 Ubiquiti 的 UniFi 无线 AP、交换机与网关：设备采纳、Wi-Fi 与 VLAN 配置、客户端与流量查看、固件升级、统计报表，全部在本地网页界面完成，不依赖云端。本应用以非 root 容器运行 LinuxServer.io 的镜像，控制器数据库、配置与日志保存在应用数据目录。
zh-cn.important: 需要 DockerEngine（缺失时应用中心会提示安装）。镜像安装时从 Docker Hub 拉取，无法直连请先配置镜像加速。打开 https://NAS地址:8013/ 完成初始化向导（自签证书，浏览器会提示一次）。设备通过 8014/tcp（inform）采纳、8016/udp 发现、8015/udp（STUN）通信，请保证局域网内可访问这些端口。数据在应用数据目录，卸载并删除数据前请先备份。镜像内的控制器固定在 8.0.24（上游镜像已进入维护冻结）。
zh-cn.release_note: 1. 首次发布：来自 LinuxServer.io Docker Hub 镜像的 UniFi Network Controller 8.0.24，以非 root 容器运行，发布网页、inform、STUN 与发现端口；控制器数据与日志保存在应用数据目录。

zh-hk.descript: UniFi Network Controller 用來管理 Ubiquiti 的 UniFi 無線 AP、交換器與閘道：裝置採納、Wi-Fi 與 VLAN 設定、用戶端與流量檢視、韌體升級、統計報表，全部在本機網頁介面完成，不依賴雲端。本應用以非 root 容器執行 LinuxServer.io 的映像，控制器資料庫、設定與日誌保存在應用資料目錄。
zh-hk.important: 需要 DockerEngine（缺少時應用中心會提示安裝）。映像安裝時從 Docker Hub 下載，無法直連請先設定映像加速。開啟 https://NAS位址:8013/ 完成初始化精靈（自簽憑證，瀏覽器會提示一次）。裝置透過 8014/tcp（inform）採納、8016/udp 探索、8015/udp（STUN）通訊，請確保區域網路內可存取這些連接埠。資料在應用資料目錄，解除安裝並刪除資料前請先備份。映像內的控制器固定在 8.0.24（上游映像已進入維護凍結）。
zh-hk.release_note: 1. 首次發佈：來自 LinuxServer.io Docker Hub 映像的 UniFi Network Controller 8.0.24，以非 root 容器執行，發佈網頁、inform、STUN 與探索連接埠；控制器資料與日誌保存在應用資料目錄。
